name: Corporate Action Instructed Balance Option Balance SD 3
definition: Provides additional information regarding corporate action instructed balance details at option level.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: Xpath to the element that is being extended.

OptionNumber.name: Option Number
OptionNumber.definition: Option Number of the extended balances.

OptionUncoveredProtectBalance.name: Option Uncovered Protect Balance
OptionUncoveredProtectBalance.definition: Balance of uncovered protect transactions at an option level.

OptionOversubscriptionQuantity.name: Option Oversubscription Quantity
OptionOversubscriptionQuantity.definition: For rights subscription events, total number of oversubscribed units. When there is an oversubscription privilege, this quantity will be included within the Instructed quantity in the core message.

OptionUnacceptedBalance.name: Option Unaccepted Balance
OptionUnacceptedBalance.definition: For election merger events, the balance that is being moved into another option number for payment due to the proration of the original option.
